author: JeanPRT
quote: 13 years of development and over 1.5 million dollars, only to deliver a game that runs at 30 fps (or even less, in reality), lacks a physical release, and feels more like a piece of DLC for GTA V—all while employing anti-consumer practices. On top of that, the story is nothing special; it brings absolutely no innovation to the table—it’s essentially GTA V with RDR2’s mechanics.

author: JeanPRT
quote: A classic, revamped for a new generation of gamers; you can’t die without having played this game—I’ve already beaten it several times myself.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
